source.name: NewYork-Presbyterian newsroom: New York Mets Announce Multi-Year Partnership with NewYork-Presbyterian
source.quote: As a symbol of the integrated partnership, a NewYork-Presbyterian patch will be featured on the Mets uniforms, the first jersey patch partnership in the team’s 61-year history.
source.note: Still the Mets' uniform ad in 2026: SportsLogos.net's MLB Team-by-Team Jersey Ads Tracker (https://news.sportslogos.net/2024/07/31/mlb-jersey-ads-by-team/baseball/, updated 2026-02-18) lists the Mets patch as New York-Presbyterian, and as of 18 Feb 2026 only the Tampa Bay Rays wear no ad on their uniform.

summary: Jersey patch: NewYork-Presbyterian, the club's only uniform ad (MLB permits one ad patch per jersey).
